definition: Formal x r: x has r in its own kind. Virtual x r: x has the power to produce r without having it in its own kind. InActUnder t P fixes the abstract InAct of ST I q.4 a.2: respects in P count only formally, others formally or virtually. Contains t P is the q.4 a.2 reading under that fixing.
note: Analyst fixing of the parameter left open by DISAMB-IN-ACT. Which respects belong to P is the open question. See docs/notes/physical-ground-468.md.
